(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No. : DSWA/LND/4/ACQI/F1/46. Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/5/2020/HW/151. I, hereby give notice under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following piece of lands required for the Widening Walasmulla - Weeraketiya Road under development of Walasmulla Town. Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of 2 lands (Lot Nos. 1 & 2) depicted in Cadastral Map No. 830470, situated in the Village of Walasmulla in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 454, Walasmulla East in the Divisional Secretary's Division of

Walasmulla in Hambanthota District in Southern Province. 01. Lot No. 1 Name of Land : Mirisiyanwatta; Claimant : State; Original Claimant : Mahanama Geeganagamage, Weeraketiya Road, Walasmulla; Present Land Use : Road (Road Development Authority); Extent : 0.0054 Hectare 02. Lot No. 2 Name of Land : Mirisiyanwatta; Claimant : State; Original Claimant : Dharmapala Maddumage (Late of), Oluuara, Walasmulla; Present Land Use : Road (Road Development Authority); Extent : 0.0111 Hectare All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, of Walasmulla on the 19.05.2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate)
